name: Six of Swords
meaning_for_today: Today indicates transition, moving away from difficulties, and slowly heading toward calmer and more stable conditions. It suggests emotional or mental recovery through change.
card_advice: Allow yourself to move on from what no longer serves you. Even if the journey feels uncertain, trust that it leads toward healing and stability.

upright.general: The Six of Swords represents transition from difficulty to calmer waters. It often symbolizes a physical or emotional journey away from conflict, stress, or hardship. This card suggests healing through distance, change, or mental shift toward clarity and peace.
upright.in_love: In love, it can indicate moving away from a troubled relationship or healing after emotional difficulties. It may also represent a relationship transitioning into a calmer, more stable phase.
upright.in_situation: In situations, it points to relocation, change, or gradual improvement after a difficult period. It emphasizes problem-solving through distance and perspective shift.

reversed.short: Stagnation, resistance to change, emotional baggage.
reversed.general: Reversed, the Six of Swords suggests difficulty moving on, emotional resistance to change, or staying stuck in a stressful situation. It may indicate unresolved issues blocking progress.
reversed.in_love: In relationships, it can show inability to move past problems, returning to toxic dynamics, or emotional confusion about leaving or staying.
reversed.in_situation: In situations, it warns of delays in transition, fear of change, or repeating old patterns instead of progressing forward.
